type PrimitiveWhen<V> = V extends boolean ? string : number;
type ConditionalUnion<V> = PrimitiveWhen<V> | {name: string};
type ObjectsWhen<V> = V extends boolean ? {name: string} : {id: number};

function wrapArray<V, T extends (V extends boolean ? string : number) & {}>(value: T, marker: V): T[] {
  return [value];
}
function wrapObject<V, T extends ConditionalUnion<V>>(value: T, marker: V): {value: T} {
  return {value};
}
function wrapAlias<V, T extends PrimitiveWhen<V> & {}>(value: T, marker: V): {value: T} {
  return {value};
}
function wrapNumbers<V, T extends (ObjectsWhen<V> | PrimitiveWhen<V>) & {}>(value: T, marker: V): T[] {
  return [value];
}

const a = wrapArray('array', true);
const b = wrapObject('object', true);
const c = wrapAlias('alias', true);
const d = wrapNumbers(4, 'number');
const array: 'array' = a[0];
const object: 'object' = b.value;
const alias: 'alias' = c.value;
const number: 4 = d[0];
console.log(array, object, alias, number);
